perfil: Eleanor, both a noble lady and a traveler, excels at switching weapons fluidly to unleash varied attacks and confuse her enemies with versatile tactics.

habilidades.b: Quickly switches weapons to unleash ruthless strikes, dealing multiple rapid instances of DMG. Eleanor can automatically spend ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ to activate Cross Slash, dealing AoE DMG.

tpl.s: Quickly switches among multiple weapons to attack. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Eleanor has ⟨Tactical Energy⟩. She can automatically spend 10 ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ to activate Cross Slash, dealing ⟦5⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Cross Slash can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩ and create a Blossom, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Ventus Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Spins rapidly to deal AoE DMG and gains Vigil: multiple ⟨Sentry⟩ move around Eleanor to deal DMG over time.

tpl.s: Spins rapidly to deal ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG and gains the Vigil effect: multiple ⟨Sentry⟩ move around Eleanor for 10s, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG at intervals. Sentry Deployment (Main Skill) can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩ and create Blossom, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as AoE Ventus Mark DMG.

habilidades.b: Performs multiple jump slams, dealing AoE DMG. Slams generate ⟨Sentry⟩ that attack targets and deal DMG.

tpl.s: Performs multiple jump slams, triggering explosions that deal ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG. Every third slam generates 1 ⟨Sentry⟩ for 3s. Up to 3 Sentries can exist at the same time. ⟨Sentry⟩ can fire bullets that deal ⟦1⟧ of Eleanor's ATK as Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Armed Assault (Support Skill) can inflict ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩.

habilidades.b: Eleanor fires a barrage of rockets, dealing multiple instances of AoE DMG.

tpl.s: Eleanor fires a barrage of rockets, dealing AoE Ventus Ultimate DMG equal to ⟦0⟧ of ATK.

builds.d: An Auto Attack build that restores Tactical Energy over time to cast enhanced Cross Slash at high frequency.
A skill build that expertly controls sentries to deal DMG in a large area to hordes of enemies.

l.b: Increases the number of attacks and Ventus DMG of Cross Slash. Reduces the cooldown for gaining ⟨Tactical Energy⟩.
l.s: Cross Slash can attack 1 additional time. Increases Cross Slash's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧. While Vigil is active, reduces the cooldown for gaining ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ for Eleanor's Auto Attacks by 1s.

l.b: When ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ is gained or consumed, fires 1 bomb. Reduces the ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ consumed by Cross Slash.
l.s: Whenever Eleanor gains or spends ⟨Tactical Energy⟩, fires 1 bomb that deals AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG equal to ⟦0⟧ of ATK and can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩. Reduces the ⟨Tactical Energy⟩ consumed by Cross Slash by 4.

l.b: Cross Slash can trigger additional explosions. Increases Cross Slash's Ventus DMG.
l.s: Cross Slash can trigger additional explosions, dealing AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG equal to ⟦0⟧ of ATK. Increases Cross Slash's Ventus DMG against elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: The last Auto Attack strike can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩. During Vigil, increases Eleanor's Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: The last Auto Attack strike can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩. During Vigil, increases Eleanor's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Reduces Vigil's Attack Interval. When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: Reduces Vigil's Attack Interval. When casting Cross Slash, increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s.

l.b: Vigil can deal additional AoE Ventus Skill DMG. When casting the Main Skill, increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG.
l.s: When Eleanor's Vigil deals DMG to a target 2 times, it can deal an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Skill DMG. When casting Sentry Deployment (Main Skill), increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Increases Vigil's Attack Range and its Skill DMG.
l.s: Increases Vigil's Attack Range and its Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Main Skill, increases Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: When casting Sentry Deployment (Main Skill), each target near Eleanor increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 10s, up to 3 stacks.

l.b: When Auto Attack DMG is dealt, increases Eleanor's Skill DMG.
l.s: When Eleanor deals Auto Attack DMG, increases her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 5 times. This effect can only be triggered once per sec.

l.b: When triggering ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases the ATK of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: When triggering ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases the ATK of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩. Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG.
l.s: Firestorm (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Ventus Mark⟩. Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Decreases Dodge cooldown. Increases Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: Decreases Dodge cooldown by 25%. Increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG.
l.s: When Eleanor casts Firestorm (Ultimate), increases her Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 25s.

l.b: Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG. When the Ultimate deals DMG to a target, increases the Ultimate DMG it deals.
l.s: Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Firestorm (Ultimate) deals DMG to a target, increases the Ultimate DMG it deals to the target by ⟦1⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases Eleanor's ATK. When any Ventus Trekker in the squad casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Eleanor's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧. When any Ventus Trekker in the squad casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Eleanor's Ultimate DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

builds.d: Increases the Attack Range and the number of attacks with each jump slam, making it easy to handle waves of enemies.
Summons long-lasting sentries to rapidly attack designated targets, dealing concentrated DMG to enemies in a small area.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Skill Crit Rate and the number of explosions.
l.s: Increases the Skill Crit Rate of jump slam explosions from Armed Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. Increases the number of explosions of each jump slam by 1. Resets when the Support Skill ends.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Skill Crit DMG, Attack Range, and DMG multiplier.
l.s: Increases the Skill Crit DMG of jump slam explosions from Armed Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧. When there is only 1 Support Trekker in the squad, increases the Attack Range and DMG multiplier of each jump slam's explosion. After each explosion, increases DMG multiplier dealt by the following jump slam explosions by ⟦1⟧, stacking up to 9 times.

l.b: Increases the Support Skill's Skill Crit Rate and DMG multiplier of its jump slam explosions.
l.s: Increases the Skill Crit Rate of jump slam explosions from Armed Assault (Support Skill) by 20% and their DMG multiplier by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When jump slam explosions from the Support Skill deal DMG, increases Eleanor's Skill DMG and the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's Skill Crit DMG.
l.s: When jump slam explosions from Armed Assault (Support Skill) deal DMG, increases Eleanor's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 10 times. Increases the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's Skill Crit DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 15 times.

l.b: Increases the DMG multiplier and Ventus DMG of jump slam explosions from the Support Skill.
l.s: Increases the DMG multiplier of jump slam explosions from Armed Assault (Support Skill) by ⟦0⟧ and Ventus DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ ATK. Each time a ⟨Sentry⟩ is generated, extends the duration of all existing ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field. The Support Skill can increase ⟨Sentry⟩ DMG multiplier.
l.s: Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ ATK by ⟦0⟧. Each time a ⟨Sentry⟩ is generated, extends the duration of all existing ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field. Each jump slam from Armed Assault (Support Skill) increases ⟨Sentry⟩ DMG multiplier by ⟦1⟧ for 3s, stacking up to 9 times.

l.b: ⟨Sentry⟩ deal additional AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG. Each ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field increases ATK SPD of all ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field.
l.s: When ⟨Sentry⟩ bullets deal DMG to the Main Trekker's target 3 times, deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Ventus Auto Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. Each ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field increases ATK SPD of all ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: Increases the size of bullets fired by ⟨Sentry⟩. Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: Increases the size of bullets fired by ⟨Sentry⟩, which can penetrate targets. Increases the Auto Attack DMG of ⟨Sentry⟩ against elite or higher-tier targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ ATK. ⟨Sentry⟩ can increase the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ ATK by ⟦0⟧. When there are 3 ⟨Sentry⟩ on the field, increases the Ventus Vanguard Main Trekker's Auto Attack DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 10s.

l.b: Increases ⟨Sentry⟩ Auto Attack DMG and Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: Increases the Auto Attack DMG ⟨Sentry⟩ deal to the Main Trekker's target by ⟦0⟧ and Eleanor's ATK by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: The Ultimate can inflict ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩. When Eleanor deals DMG to a target, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken.
l.s: Firestorm (Ultimate) can inflict ⟨Ventus Mark: Breeze⟩. When Eleanor deals DMG to a target, increases the target's Ventus DMG Taken by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

l.b: When triggering ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Eleanor's ATK.
l.s: When any Trekker in the squad triggers ⟨Ventus Mark⟩, increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: When Eleanor deals DMG, increases the Ventus DMG of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad.
l.s: When Eleanor deals DMG, increases the Ventus DMG of all Ventus Trekkers in the squad by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to 10 times.

l.b: When casting the Ultimate, increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG.
l.s: When Eleanor casts Firestorm (Ultimate), increases her Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 25s.

l.b: Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG. When the Ultimate deals DMG to a target, increases the Ultimate DMG it deals.
l.s: Increases Eleanor's Ventus DMG by ⟦0⟧. When Firestorm (Ultimate) deals DMG to a target, increases the Ultimate DMG it deals to the target by ⟦1⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases Eleanor's ATK. When any Ventus Trekker in the squad casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Eleanor's Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Increases Eleanor's ATK by ⟦0⟧. When any Ventus Trekker in the squad casts a Main Skill or Support Skill, increases Eleanor's Ultimate DMG by ⟦1⟧ for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.
